title: Automated Product Strategy Synthesis
business: Product management teams at mid-sized software firms.
problem: Product managers struggle to synthesize fragmented feedback from multiple retrospective boards into actionable strategy documents, leading to lost insights and delayed planning.
solution: The Claude-Miro connector enables the AI to programmatically scan existing retrospective boards, extract key themes, and automatically generate a new, structured strategy board containing organized sticky notes and summary tables.
steps: Authenticate the Claude-Miro connector to grant access to the team's workspace boards.
Use board_search_boards to identify relevant retrospective boards based on project tags.
Invoke context_explore to pull themes and decisions from the identified boards.
Execute board_create to initialize a new strategy canvas.
Utilize table_create and sticky note generation tools to populate the new board with synthesized insights.
outcome: Teams achieve faster alignment on product priorities by reducing manual documentation time and ensuring that historical retrospective data directly informs future strategy.
limitation: The connector relies on the AI's ability to interpret board context; if boards are poorly structured or lack clear labels, the synthesis may be inaccurate. Users should verify the generated board content against the source boards to ensure data fidelity.
